register.labelZh: LIE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: lie down 表示躺下休息;lie in 表示比平日遲起床;lie around 則表示閒着,沒有做甚麼事情。；lie before 可以描述展現在某人眼前的景象;lie ahead 則可以描述未來的機會、問題或經歷。；lie with 可以清楚說明由誰負責,或由誰作出決定。；lie about 可用來談論隨處擺放而沒有收好的衣物、書本、玩具或其他物件。；當某人躲藏起來,等待安全時才再次行動,故事中可能會使用 lie up。
register.summaryEn: Lie down describes moving into a resting position, lie in means staying in bed later, and lie around describes spending time doing very little. Lie before can describe a view in front of someone, while lie ahead can describe future chances, problems or experiences. Lie with helps you state clearly who has the duty or power to make a decision. Lie about is useful when talking about clothes, books, toys or other things left untidily in different places. Lie up may appear in stories when a person hides somewhere and waits until it is safe to move again.

questions.prompt: Great opportunities are waiting for you in the future.
questions.promptZh: 未來有很多大好機會等待着你。
